notes: Theme: kept data-theme="dark" on all six wrappers. maude-v2 is light-first; switching is one word per wrapper.

Presence: the canvas uses --presence-agent for the 'on a draft' amber state. In maude-v2 that role is coral and reserved for AI presence (CONTRACT §6, C32), so the draft state would read as an AI marker. Needs a decision: move the draft tint to --status-warn, or accept.
Accent: the fold-back CTA is a filled --accent button. In maude-v2 that's azure, the colour Share uses ('Share stays the one solid azure'). Check whether two solid azure buttons on screen is OK.
Words: 'Project' and 'draft / Shared version' are fine against the CONTRACT; 'Open another folder…' would be 'Open project… ⌘O' in maude-v2 words. Copy is not changed here.
Token-level look shifts: accent indigo → azure, larger radii, system UI / SF Mono fonts.
